properties.name: redis.stream.enabled
properties.description: Feature flag for redis.

properties.name: redis.stream.retention-seconds
properties.description: How long a chat's buffered SSE frames survive past their most recent frame, as a sliding expiry. This is the window in which a client backgrounded mid-turn can resume; past it the resume endpoint answers 410 Gone and the client must fall back to polling the persisted chat. Also what bounds Redis memory, since the streams are otherwise never deleted. Defaults to 900.

properties.name: redis.stream.keepalive-seconds
properties.description: How long a stream may be silent before an SSE keepalive comment is written. A turn that is still thinking emits no bytes at all, and a text/event-stream carrying nothing is the first thing a mobile radio, load balancer or proxy reaps. Must be comfortably below the shortest read timeout in front of the API. Defaults to 15.

properties.name: redis.stream.lookup-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Ceiling on the Redis lookups the resume endpoint makes to decide its status code. These run on the request thread so the status can be sent before the response is committed; exceeding this answers 503 rather than hanging. Defaults to 5.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.slash-commands.cache.ttl-seconds
properties.description: Time-to-live for slash-command prompt catalog cache, in seconds.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.slash-commands.cache.warmup-on-startup
properties.description: Whether to pre-populate slash-command prompt catalog cache on application startup.

properties.name: solesonic.mcp.reconnect.enabled
properties.description: Experimental: enables automatic reconnection to the MCP server after a connection loss, with exponential backoff. Disabled by default.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.etl.openai.read-timeout
properties.description: Read timeout for the ETL model client. Must exceed the time to cold-load the ETL model, otherwise the first request aborts with a timeout instead of waiting for the load.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.vision.openai.read-timeout
properties.description: Read timeout for the vision model client. A cold vision-model load routinely outlives a default read timeout and surfaces as a timeout on the first image rather than a wait.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.embedding.model
properties.description: Embedding model name. Changing it changes the vectors, so an existing corpus must be re-ingested rather than mixed.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.rag-task.model
properties.description: Model used for RAG query rewriting, multi-query expansion and document reranking. Required; no default.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.tool-call.model
properties.description: Model used to turn a slash command into a single tool call. Required; no default.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.uri.ingestion.read-timeout
properties.description: Read timeout for fetching content from a uri submitted for RAG ingestion. Defaults to 30s.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.uri.ingestion.max-bytes
properties.description: Maximum response body size accepted when fetching content from a uri submitted for RAG ingestion. Defaults to 20MB.

properties.name: google.oauth.auth-uri
properties.description: Google's authorization endpoint, where the user is sent to consent.

properties.name: google.oauth.base-uri
properties.description: Base URI of Google's OAuth2 token and revocation endpoints.

properties.name: google.oauth.client-id
properties.description: OAuth2 client ID of the Google Cloud project's web application client.

properties.name: google.oauth.client-secret
properties.description: OAuth2 client secret paired with google.oauth.client-id.

properties.name: google.api.uri
properties.description: Base URI for the Gmail API.

properties.name: google.api.auth.callback.uri
properties.description: Redirect URI Google returns the authorization code to. Must match a redirect URI registered on the OAuth client exactly.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.memory.model
properties.description: Model user-memory reflection runs against. Never follows a chat's /model selection. Required; no default.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.memory.openai.read-timeout
properties.description: Read timeout for the memory model client. Required; no default.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.memory.reflection.enabled
properties.description: Whether the memory reflection task runs. An operational switch for the whole deployment.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.memory.reflection.cron
properties.description: Schedule of the memory reflection task.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.memory.reflection.idle-minutes
properties.description: How long a conversation must be quiet before reflection reads it, and how old an IN_PROGRESS claim must be before it can be taken over.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.memory.reflection.batch-size
properties.description: Conversations claimed per reflection tick, processed one model call at a time.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.memory.reflection.max-attempts
properties.description: Failures after which a conversation is no longer reflected on.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.memory.reflection.max-transcript-characters
properties.description: Size of one reflection window. Longer conversations are read across several runs; nothing is skipped.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.memory.reflection.shown-memories
properties.description: Existing memories shown to the reflection model: those nearest the conversation, or all of them when the user has no more than this.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.memory.reflection.duplicate-similarity
properties.description: Cosine similarity at or above which a proposed addition is treated as an existing live memory said again.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.memory.retention.enabled
properties.description: Whether the memory retention sweep runs.

properties.name: solesonic.user.lifecycle.enabled
properties.description: Whether the hourly sweep purges the memory data of removed and dormant users.

properties.name: solesonic.user.lifecycle.cron
properties.description: Schedule of the user lifecycle sweep.

properties.name: solesonic.user.lifecycle.dormant-days
properties.description: Days without a message of their own after which a user is dormant: their memory data is purged and reflection skips them.

properties.name: solesonic.user.lifecycle.keycloak-recheck-hours
properties.description: How long a Keycloak lookup of a user is trusted before it is made again.

properties.name: solesonic.user.keycloak.admin-uri
properties.description: Keycloak admin REST base for the user realm, e.g. https://auth.example.com/admin/realms/izzy-bot.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.memory.retention.cron
properties.description: Schedule of the memory retention sweep.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.memory.retention.pending-days
properties.description: Days an inferred pending memory may go unconfirmed before the retention sweep removes it.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.memory.retention.min-score
properties.description: Decayed score below which the retention sweep removes an active inferred memory.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.memory.injection.enabled
properties.description: Whether active memories are put in the plain-chat system prompt.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.memory.prompt-max-characters
properties.description: Ceiling on the memory block in the system prompt.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.memory.max-active-memories
properties.description: Active memories kept per user; past it the weakest inferred memory is evicted.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.memory.max-memory-characters
properties.description: Longest single memory, for the panel and for reflection.

properties.name: solesonic.llm.memory.min-confidence
properties.description: Reflection proposals below this confidence are dropped.
